plainEnglish: Understand the behavior behind Microprocessors & ARM Architecture, trace it with evidence, and transfer it to a fresh case.

Trace a normal case before relying on a simulator or supplied answer.
Trace at least one boundary or failure case.
Justify each major instruction, rule, or calculation.
Verify the final observable state or result with explicit evidence.
State assumptions clearly when browser execution cannot reproduce the target hardware.
